events.summary: Liliana raises a dead servant, asking if it had a nice nap.
events.quote: Did you have a nice nap?

events.summary: Urza finds silver passes through the portal undamaged and designs a golem of it.
events.quote: He immediately designed a golem made of the metal.

events.summary: Sheoldred declares many worlds will bow to Phyrexia.
events.quote: I believe many worlds will bow to Phyrexia. Mirrodin is merely the first.

events.summary: Volrath comes to reclaim Greven as his own.
events.quote: I've come to reclaim what is mine. And you, Greven, are mine.

events.summary: Serra's realm proves as fragile as glass.
events.quote: As Serra was to learn, the peace and sanctity of her realm were as fragile as glass.

events.summary: Asha leaves Bant after ensuring protection and order.
events.quote: When Asha left Bant, she ensured that the world would have protection and order in her absence.

events.summary: Nicol Bolas threatens to punish with the ground itself.
events.quote: Where will you run when I punish you with the very ground you flee on?

events.summary: Eldrazi minds are the only ones able to open hedrons.
events.quote: Only the Eldrazi mind thinks in the warped paths required to open the hedrons and tap the power within.

relations.note: Kaseto calls Seshiro a revered ancestor.
relations.quote: Our revered ancestor Seshiro gave us wisdom greater than poison and fangs.
I believe many worlds will bow to Phyrexia.

relations.note: Karlov says ambition runs in their family.
